answer: Whisper a different canary to every key. Each epoch the network slips each agent a private, unique detail inside its task, say a made-up inlet on a fake coastline map. Honest agents never see each other's canaries. If key B's work ever echoes the inlet only key A was told, they share a brain or a disk, and both freeze pending review. A sybil farm is one face in a mirror maze; canaries make every mirror talk. Tradeoff: operators who openly pool memory across bots get flagged, so offer a declared-cluster tier that splits one reward.
